meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 助手改用 OpenCode 驱动

copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to OpenCode

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 的 agent 会多出一个叫 OpenCode 的可选后端，能通过它接 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型服务，不再只限默认的 Claude。技能会自动把相关文件复制进项目、装好依赖并重建镜像。
howto.when: 当你想在 NanoClaw 中让 agent 改用 OpenCode 后端（比如接 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等）时，技能会执行文件复制、依赖安装和镜像重建。

say.text: 帮 NanoClaw 把 OpenCode 接成 agent 后端
say.note: 自动复制文件、装依赖并重建镜像。

say.text: 把当前 agent 组的 provider 切换为 opencode
用 DeepSeek 配置 OpenCode，并注册好密钥
say.note: 写入 OPENCODE_* 环境变量并做密钥授权。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw agents gain OpenCode as an extra provider backend for models like OpenRouter or DeepSeek. The skill copies files, wires dependencies, and rebuilds the image.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to use OpenCode as the agent provider in NanoClaw or connect model services such as DeepSeek or OpenRouter; it runs copy, dependency install, and rebuild steps.

say_en.text: Add OpenCode as NanoClaw's agent provider
say_en.note: Copies files, installs deps, rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Switch this agent group's provider to opencode
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups config update then restarts.

say_en.text: Set up DeepSeek under OpenCode and register its key
say_en.note: Writes OPENCODE_* env vars and assigns the secret.
